title: 第11章 我要红了！嘎＄＄
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嘎！嘎…”

乌鸦们惊慌振翅，却又很勇敢地挡在少女身前摆出戒备守护的姿态。

莱恩降落后带起的气流掀起了少女的裙摆，惹得女孩对他怒目而视：“你是哪个预备队的，怎么随意闯入我的地盘！”

超能者之间存在竞争关系，那些还没能得到沃特公司签约认可的新人，彼此间的角逐更是格外激烈。

像乌鸦女伯爵这种预备队选手，她们的竞争比那还要更残酷，甚至涉及到生死存亡。

毕竟饭都要吃不上了，是吧。

尤其在纽约这个寸土寸金之地，超能者更是被严格划分好区域的。

领地意识更强一些的少女，见到超人类的第一反应，就是又来了一个抢地盘的人。

她已经被赶走过好几次了，这一次好不容易找到个暂时没有预备队占据的街区，结果没高兴两天就从天而降了个……

“这么小就出来抛头露面了？”才看清莱恩样貌的少女诧异一句。

“预备队？那是什么？”

莱恩同样回以疑问。

但刚问完，他便又毫不在意地摆摆手，道：“算了，那不重要，我只是找个人打听个路。”

“你知道超级七人塔在哪吗，纽约太大了。”

乌鸦们落回了少女肩膀，少女侧着头作出倾听状，等乌鸦说完，她才回道：“卡梅隆告诉我你没有恶意，我可以给你指路。”

“呃…小孩，你去沃特塔做什么，你年纪这么小，预备队不会收下你吧？”

又一次提及的预备队引起了莱恩的好奇：“所以说预备队到底是什么，我从来没听说过，你能解释一下吗？”

莱恩上辈子定格的时候连第四季大结局都没有看到，当然不知道眼前的少女是谁。

自然也就不知道什么预备队，什么少年英雄团体了。

“预备队当然就是……”

“嗷。”

莱恩恍然。

虽然楼顶上这位挂着很浓烟熏妆的少女讲的有点稀里糊涂，但他很会归纳总结、提炼要点。

简单来说预备队的作用就是：

人才储备——给七人队培养、筛选替补，主力出事随时顶上。

商业变现——主打青少年偶像市场，做社交网红、卖周边、接代言。

基层干活——处理城市小案件、救灾、巡逻（大部分都是摆拍），脏活累活他们上。

明白了预备队是个什么产物后，莱恩打量了一下眼前的少女，又四下在楼顶上扫视一圈。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Ga! Ga..."

The crows flapped their wings in panic, but bravely stood in front of the girl in a defensive posture.

The air flow brought up by Ryan after landing lifted the hem of the girl's skirt, causing the girl to glare at him: "Which reserve team are you from? Why did you intrude on my territory at will?"

There is competition among superpowers, and the competition among newcomers who have not yet been signed by Walter Company is particularly fierce.

For reserve players like Countess Crow, their competition is even more cruel than that, even involving life and death.

After all, you won’t be able to eat anymore, right?

Especially in New York, a place where every inch of land is precious, superpowers are strictly divided into areas.

The first reaction of a girl with a stronger sense of territoriality when seeing a superhuman is that another person is coming to grab the territory.

She had been driven away several times. This time she finally found a block that was not temporarily occupied by reserve teams. As a result, she was not happy when one fell from the sky in two days...

"You come out to the public at such a young age?" The girl who just saw Ryan's appearance was surprised.

"Reserves? What's that?"

Ryan responded with the same question.

But as soon as he finished asking, he waved his hand nonchalantly and said, "Forget it, that's not important. I'm just looking for someone to ask for directions."

"Do you know where the Super Seven Tower is? New York is too big."

The crows landed on the girl's shoulders, and the girl tilted her head as if listening. After the crows finished speaking, she replied: "Cameron, tell me you mean no harm, and I can show you the way."

"Uh...kid, why are you going to Water Tower? You are so young, the reserve team won't accept you, right?"

The mention of the reserve team again aroused Ryan's curiosity: "So what exactly is the reserve team? I have never heard of it. Can you explain it?"

Ryan hadn't even seen the Season 4 finale when his previous life was frozen, so of course he didn't know who the girl in front of him was.

Naturally, I don’t know what a reserve team is or what a young hero group is.

"Of course the reserve team is..."

"Ouch."

Ryan was stunned.

Although the girl with a thick smoky makeup on the roof spoke a little vaguely, he was very good at summarizing and refining the key points.

Simply put, the role of the reserve team is:

Talent reserve - train and select substitutes for the seven-man team, so that the main force can step in at any time if something goes wrong.

Commercial realization - focusing on the youth idol market, becoming a social media celebrity, selling peripherals, and accepting endorsements.

They work at the grassroots level - handling small urban cases, disaster relief, patrolling (most of which are staged for photos), and they do the dirty work.

After understanding what the reserve team was, Ryan looked at the girl in front of him, and then looked around on the roof of the building.
